defects.what: The whole picture sits inside a white margin and a black outline, a visible frame around the image.
Plates of food are superimposed over the woman's face like a double-exposure collage, cutting across her eyes and cheeks.
A hanging scroll with large kanji and a wooden sign with Japanese/Chinese characters on the kitchen wall in a Kawit house.
Two big white hanging shop signs with Chinese/Japanese characters on the left wall of the flooded Kawit alley, also mirrored in the water.
A green shop sign with Chinese characters on the building behind Indio at upper left.
Posters on the left wall carry pseudo-Japanese headline glyphs and red pseudo-text blocks, and the poster at right has red lettering.
A white logo badge with red letters is drawn in the top-left corner, plus pseudo-letters on a sign at upper right.
The dog at the table has two tall pointed ears, no red kerchief and no white chest patch, so it does not read as Usman.
A cyan signature-like scribble is drawn in the bottom-right corner.
Usman has no red kerchief (both ears also drop the same way).
Japanese-like glyphs painted on the building facade at upper right.
Usman has two upright pointed ears instead of one folded ear.
A paper notice with rows of pseudo-text is pinned on the kitchen wall behind the father.
A small poster with red kanji-like glyphs hangs in the window at upper left.
A red logo emblem on the chest of the man's polo shirt at right.
The billboard on the riverbank shows pseudo-text lines and red glyphs instead of illegible scribbles.
Small shop signs with kanji-like glyphs at the top of the street behind Indio.
A small sign with pseudo-text over the barangay hall door.
The coastal town looks like a Japanese suburb, with small shop signs in Japanese-like characters on the central building.
Two small lit shop signs with glyphs on the left houses along the flooded street.
Small signs with pseudo-letters on the buildings behind Indio.
Indio wears a collared white shirt instead of the collarless off-white period shirt; the glowing ring behind him also carries rows of glyphs.
